title: ‘The Office’ U.K. Actress Lucy Davis Reveals “Incurable” Breast Cancer Diagnosis
summary: "As of now, I’m trying to live out whatever might be left of my life in as fun a way as I possibly can," Davis wrote on Instagram. "I always like to find the teachable moments in anything negative that happens. And cancer has not disappointed in that regard; there’s a lot I have learned from it, and I’m grateful for that."
